title: GOD OF THE 11TH HOUR
text: Glory to the name of Jesus Christ. We are in the presence of almighty God. There is something that the spirit of God wants to do in this place tonight. There are people who are tired. There are people who thought they had reached the end of the line. Some of you believe the story was over. Some of you have written the conclusion to your own narrative. But the God we serve is the God of the 11th hour. Do you know what the 11th hour means? When you have 12 hours of daylight, the 11th hour is the last hour. It's 1 hour before everything shuts down. Is when things look impossibly dark. Is when the odds are entirely against you. Is when every natural eye says there is no way forward. That is when our God steps in. That is his specialtity. That is the season we are entering right now. I want you to share this message with someone. Share it with your family. Send it to that person who has lost hope because God is saying your story is not finished. Your testimony is not concluded. There is a divine reset coming. There is a supernatural pivot about to happen in your life. The systems of hell have been working over time to convince you that you are finished. But I bring good news. You are about to enter the greatest season of your life. Listen carefully. Listen carefully to what I am about to minister to you. There are dimensions to this that the average eye cannot see. There are realms to this that requires spiritual sensitivity. The God we are talking about does not operate in the natural realm only. He operates in the realm of the supernatural. He operates in the realm where time is irrelevant. He operates in the realm where impossibility becomes possibility. Let me read from Genesis 21:1-3. And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said. And the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken. For Sarah conceived and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken unto him. And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, Isaac. Sarah was 90 years old. Abraham was a hund. The biological clock had stopped. Every doctor in Egypt would have said, "This is not happening." Every midwife would have laughed. Every expectation of human possibility would have been exhausted. That is the 11th hour. That is when God works. Sarah was at the end of her reproductive years. In fact, she was beyond the end. She was in the cemetery of impossibility and in that very hour God visited her. Thus said the spirit of God, "There are men and women under the sound of my voice who are in your 11th hour. The enemies have already arranged your funeral. The forces of darkness have already written the epitap on your grave. But I'm here to tell you, God is about to do something that will shock the kingdom of darkness. God is about to perform a miracle that will leave the devil dazed and confused. You have to understand something about the God we serve. He does not get nervous when your back is against the wall. He does not panic when your resources are exhausted. He does not feel overwhelmed when every door is shut. In fact, that is the moment he feels the most at home. That is when his power becomes most manifest. I read in Psalm 27:10, when my father and mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up. When everybody has abandoned you, when everybody has run away, when every natural support system has collapsed, the Lord steps in. He becomes your father. He becomes your provider. He becomes your vindicator. He becomes your restorer. He becomes your healer. He becomes your deliverer. There is someone here tonight who has been standing in front of a closed door for so long that you have forgotten what an open door looks like. Your prayer has been, "God, open this door." Your crying has been, "God, surely you have not forgotten me." Your intercession has been, "God, my children are looking at me with doubt in their eyes because they are wondering if their father or mother has lost touch with reality." They are wondering if our God truly exists. But I bring what to you. The night is far spent. The day is at hand. Your 11th hour is upon you. Listen to John 11 17- 21. Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave 4 days already. Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem about 15 furongs off. And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary to comfort them concerning their brother. Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou had been here, my brother had not died. Lazarus was dead 4 days. The morning had ended. The hope had dissipated. Martha was saying, "Jesus, if you had come earlier, this would have been different." But Jesus was not early. Jesus was late. Jesus came at a time that seemed to be too late. And in that 11th hour moment, Jesus did something that shook the foundation of the graveyard. He called a dead man back to life. There is a resurrection that is coming for your situation. There is a calling forth of life where death has reigned for so long. The thing that your enemy buried is about to come forth with fresh vitality. Your marriage that has been dead, it is going to come alive. Your business that has been dormant, it is going to rise again. Your health that has been declining, it is going to recover. Your children that have been lost to the kingdom of darkness, they are coming back home. I am telling you something. The God of the 11th hour is not a God who comes when everything is working fine. He is a God who comes when all the mechanisms of hell have been activated against you. He is a God who comes when your enemy has overestimated his own power. He is a God who comes when your situation looks like a casket and he opens that casket and brings out the person inside. Thus sayeth the spirit of God tonight. The season of lastm minute miracles is upon this generation. I am not talking about normal miracles. I am not talking about expected miracles. I am talking about miracles that violate every law of nature. I am talking about miracles that cause heaven and earth to stand still. I am talking about miracles that rewrite the history of your life. Turn with me to Isaiah 43 16-19. Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters, which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army, and the power. They shall lie down together. They shall not rise. They are extinct. They are quenched as to. Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. God is saying in this hour, stop looking at what you have already done. Stop reviewing your yesterdays. Stop living in the regret of what you could have been. I am about to do something new. I am about to make a way where there is no way. I am about to open rivers where there is a desert. I AM ABOUT to introduce possibilities where you have accepted impossibility. There is a woman in this place. The Lord says, "Your struggle has been long. The tears have been many. The nights have been sleepless. You have wondered if God was listening. You have wondered if heaven was aware of your pain. But the Lord says to you, "Your midnight is over." The voice that has been silent is about to speak on your behalf. The hand that seemed inactive is about to move with sudden velocity. Your 11th hour has arrived. There is a man here tonight. Your enemies have calculated your downfall. They have already arranged the shame that they are planning to bring on your name. They have already written the narrative of your failure. But the spirit of God is breaking their counsel. The spirit of God is disrupting their evil calculations. The spirit of God is saying the siege is broken. The opposition collapses. Your vindication is in motion. I decree and declare in the name of Jesus Christ that every force that has been working to destroy your future is terminated RIGHT NOW. EVERY ALTAR THAT HAS been erected to speak against your destiny catches fire. Every witchcraft that has been directed toward your life LOSES ITS POWER. EVERY COVENANT you made in ignorance is hereby broken by the blood of Jesus. There are people who are wondering about their finances. There are people who have been living from hand to mouth. There are people whose children have asked them, "Papa, why do we not have enough?" And you did not know what to say to your child because you yourself are confused about how you are surviving. But I bring what to you. Your 11th hour financial miracle is about to happen. Look at Malachi 3 10-2. Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse that there may be food in my house. Test me in this, says the Lord Almighty, and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that you will not have room enough for it. I will prevent pests from devouring your crops, and the grapes on your vines will not drop before their time. Then all the nations will call you blessed for yours will be a delightful land says the Lord Almighty. The Lord is not talking about small blessings. He is not talking about average provision. He is talking about such an abundance that you will not have room to contain it. Your 11 hour is when that floodgate opens. You have been faithful. You have been standing. You have not abandoned your covenant with God, even when it would have been easier to do so. And now the Lord is about to reward your faithfulness with a multiplication that will astound you. Someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord says, "Your promotion is written in heaven." They did not think you would make it. They did not believe you would survive. They prophesied your failure. But the Lord says, "I am lifting you to a position of influence that will surprise even those closest to you. Your enemies will look at your elevation and they will be confused. They will say, "How did this happen?" The Lord says, "It was my hand. It was my favor. It was my timing." Listen to what the spirit of God is saying. There is no one listening to this word right now who is beyond the reach of God. There is no situation in your life that is too complicated for the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. There is no circumstance that is beyond the purview of the Almighty. He sees you. He knows you. He has not forgotten you. And in your 11th hour, he is about to act. >> I want to take you to Luke 1:es 26-38. And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee named Nazareth, to a virgin espouseed to a man, whose name was Joseph of the house of David. And the virgin's name was Mary. And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favored, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women. And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be. Mary was a young girl. She was living in Nazareth, a place so insignificant that when Nathaniel heard Jesus was from Nazareth, he said, "Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?" Mary had no fame. She had no resources. She had no connections. She was literally a nobody in the eyes of the world. But at her 11th hour, when she was a virgin girl with no credentials and no platform, God came to her with a message. The Lord says, "Thou art highly favored. Thou art blessed among women. Thou art going to be the mother of the savior of the world." That is how the 11th hour works. It is when you have nothing that God comes and gives you everything. It is when you are invisible that God makes you visible. It is when the world has no use for you that heaven declares your worth. It is when your situation looks completely over that God opens the door of your destiny. Thus, sayeth the spirit of God, there are young people listening to this word and the enemy has told you that your future is limited. The enemy has told you that because of where you came from, because of your family background, because of the poverty you grew up in, you cannot go far. But the Lord says, "I see you. I know you. And I am about to launch you into prominence. Your 11th hour is when I am about to use you to change nations." Let me read from 1st Samuel 16:es 10-13. Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, "The Lord had not chosen these." And Samuel said unto Jesse, "A hear all thy children." And he said, There remainth yet the youngest, and behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, "Send and fetch him, for we will not sit down till he come hither." And he sent and brought him in. Now he was ready and with all of a beautiful countenance and goodly to look to. And the Lord said, "Arise, anoint him, for this is he." Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brethren. David was the youngest. He was so insignificant that when Samuel came to anoint the next king of Israel, David's own father did not even bother to call him in from the field where he was tending sheep. He was a shepherd boy. He had no throne. He had no palace. He had no armies under his command. But in his 11th hour, when he was anointed, he became the greatest king that Israel has ever known. A man after God's own heart. There is someone here tonight who has been overlooked. Your family has not recognized your potential. Your church has not seen your calling. Your workplace has not acknowledged your contribution. You have been like the youngest son out in the field, unseen and unappreciated. But the Lord is breaking that cycle. The Lord is calling you forth. The Lord is about to anoint you for a purpose that will shock everyone who knows your name. I decree and declare by the power of the blood of Jesus that every limitation placed on your life is hereby broken. Every voice that has diminished your worth is silenced. Every door that was shut against you is opened. Every opportunity that was denied to you is restored. Your 11th hour has come. Your season of lastm minute miracles is beginning right now. There are dimensions to this that the flesh cannot understand. There are spiritual realities that are happening above the physical realm right now. While you are standing here listening to this word, the angels of God are being commissioned. The spirit of the Lord is being released. Demons are being bound. Strongholds are being dismantled. Your ancestors are being broken off of your life. Your destiny is being uncovered and restored. Listen to what the spirit of God is saying. Listen carefully. The battle that you are fighting is not a natural battle. You are not fighting against flesh and blood. You are fighting against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. That is why your natural weapons are not working. That is why your natural strategies are failing because the enemy you are facing is not natural. Listen to what the spirit of God is saying. Listen carefully. The battle that you are fighting is not a natural battle. You are not fighting against flesh and blood. You are fighting against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. That is why your natural weapons are not working. That is why your natural strategies are failing. Because the enemy you are facing is not natural. Let me read from Ephesians 6:es 12-18. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Wherefore take unto you the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all to stand, stand therefore, having your loins g about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness, and your feet shaw with the preparation of the gospel of peace. Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked, and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God, praying always with all prayer and supplication in the spirit, and watching there unto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints. This is the language of warfare. This is the language of spiritual conflict. If you are going to walk into your 11th hour miracle, you have to understand that the enemy knows what God is about to do in your life. The enemy knows that a blessing is coming. The enemy knows that a breakthrough is imminent. And so, the enemy is throwing everything at you. The enemy is using sickness to distract you. The enemy is using financial pressure to discourage you. The enemy is using family conflict to divide your focus. The enemy IS USING DOUBT TO undermine your faith. But I am here to tell you something. The victory is already won. The battle has already been fought. The cross has already paid the price. Jesus Christ has already defeated the enemy. All that remains is for you to step into your victory. All that remains is for you to believe what God has already provided. All that remains is for you to walk into the 11th hour and watch the God of Abraham do what only he can do. Someone here tonight, the Lord says, "Your healing is coming." There is someone here whose body has been ravaged by disease. There is someone here whose pain has been constant. There is someone here who has lost hope that they will ever be well again. The Lord is speaking to you right now. The Lord says, "I am the God who heals. I am Jehovah Rafa. I am the one who sent my word and healed you. I am the one who took your infirmities and bore your sicknesses." Look at Matthew 8 16 and 17. When the evening was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils, and he cast out the spirit with his word, and healed all that were sick, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah's the prophet, saying, "Himself took our infirmities and bear our sicknesses." The Lord has already taken your infirmities. The Lord has already borne your sicknesses. The price has already been paid. Your healing is not something you are waiting for. Your healing is something you are stepping into. Your healing is your inheritance in Christ Jesus. In your 11th hour, the manifestation of that healing is coming. I decree and declare in the name of Jesus that every sickness that has troubled your body is broken right now. Every pain that has tormented your night is gone. Every disease that has stolen your joy is terminated. You are healed by the stripes of Jesus. You are made whole by his blood. You are restored by his power. There is a woman under the sound of my voice. The Lord says your reproductive system is being healed. Your womb is opening. The doctors have said you cannot conceive. But the Lord says differently. The Lord says I am the God of the 11th hour. I am the God who gives life where there is death. I am the God who creates where the world says it is impossible. Before the year is over, you will be holding your baby. You will be nursing your child. You will be experiencing the joy of motherhood. There is a man here tonight. The Lord says your manhood is being restored. Everything that the enemy stole from you is coming back multiplied. Your confidence is being restored. Your authority is being established. Your strength is returning. The depression that has covered you like a garment is lifted. The shame that the enemy brought on your name is being erased. Your honor is being restored. Hear the voice of the spirit of God. Hear it clearly. The assignment against your life is being aborted. The witches and warlocks who have been gathering to discuss your downfall. Their meetings are being disrupted. Their spells are being broken. Their arrows are being turned back on them. Their evil covenants are being severed. The blood of Jesus is speaking against every assignment brought against you. And that blood says my child is protected. My child is preserved. My child is mine. Let me speak to the issue of covenants for a moment. There are people in this place who are bound by covenants that were made in ignorance. Your ancestors made covenants with demonic powers. They gave their lives over to the kingdom of darkness. And because of the bloodline, because of the generational connection, you have inherited the bondage. You are suffering from causes that were not even your own doing. Your children are suffering from patterns that they did not initiate. But listen to what I'm saying. The blood of Jesus Christ is superior to every covenant. The name of Jesus is above every name. The power of the cross breaks every chain. In your 11th hour, when you call on the name of Jesus, when you plead his blood, when you declare his victory, every covenant between your family and the kingdom of darkness IS SEVERED. I HEREBY BREAK BY THE AUTHORITY given to me in CHRIST JESUS EVERY COVENANT THAT YOUR ancestors made with demons. I severe every blood oath that was sworn IN DARKNESS. I BREAK EVERY agreement between your family and the realm of the dead. I declare that you and your children are free. You are loosed. You are delivered. You belong to JESUS CHRIST AND JESUS Christ alone. Now let us move into prayer. Let us move into the realm where real power operates. Let us move into intercession that shakes the very foundation of hell. Because the God we serve has not given us a spirit of fear but of power and of love and of a sound mind. Let us pray. We come before you, oh God, in the name of Jesus Christ. We come into your presence as your children redeemed by the blood of the lamb. We come to cry out for the 11th hour miracles that only you can provide. We come to stand in the gap for ourselves and for our families. Lord God, there are people here whose situations look completely impossible. There are people here whose circumstances have violated every natural law. There are people here whose circumstances should have produced death, but your mercy is still sustaining them. We thank you for your faithfulness. We thank you for your care over us even in our ignorance. But now, oh Lord, we ask for intervention. We ask for divine action. We ask for supernatural provision. We ask for the 11th hour to be the hour of our greatest blessing. Father, we bring before you every person here whose marriage has become a battlefield, the love has died, the communication has broken down, the intimacy has been stolen, the vision has been lost. We come to you and we say, "Restore what the enemy has stolen. Breathe life back into these unions. Resurrect the love that was once there. Bring redemption to these relationships. There is a marriage that is about to receive a visitation from heaven. The woman is going to wake up and find her husband tender with her again. The man is going to look at his wife and remember why he fell in love with her. The passion is coming back. The respect is being restored. The friendship is being rebuilt in the name of Jesus. Every assignment of the devil against this marriage is broken right now. Lord God, I bring before you the children of this generation. There are young people who are caught in addiction. There are young people who have been seduced by sexual immorality. There are young people who have abandoned hope. The darkness has convinced them that their lives are over. The enemy has spoken lies over their futures. But Father, I speak to these young people right now. The 11th hour is coming. The grace of God is about to set you out. The spirit of repentance is going to break the stronghold of addiction off of your life. The blood of Jesus is going to wash away every stain of sexual sin. You are going to be restored. You are going to have a future worth living for. Your purpose is not lost. Your destiny is not cancelled. By the power of the blood of Jesus, I break the stronghold of addiction right now. Every demon that has been oppressing this generation is bound. Every stronghold that the enemy has built in the minds of our young people is demolished. Every assignment of the kingdom of darkness against our youth is aborted. Father, I bring before you the financial struggles of your people. There are people here who have applied for loans and been rejected. There are people here who have searched for jobs and found none. There are people here whose businesses have closed. There are people here whose savings have been depleted. The enemy has tried to convince them that they are cursed. The enemy has tried to convince them that they are not blessed. But father, the God of the 11th hour does not operate within the limits of the world's economy. The God of the 11th hour has not been affected by market crashes. THE GOD OF THE 11TH hour has not been limited by bank balances. The God of the 11th hour is about to release provision that will shock this generation.
